# History view

<!-- Generated by scripts/pack-page.mjs. Do not edit: change a Spec or an input, then run npm run pages. -->

The Specs a history view rests on, in reading order. A history view is a read model whose row folds the events of several streams, such as the order allocation history of the example domain. The history projection comes first because it pins the form, its fold and that view; the projection contract and the read models follow with the row conventions and the read-model rules every view shares. The rebuild, the history rebuild with its five examples, the write pause and the generation registry say how such a view comes to exist and is rebuilt while the commands that write its sources are refused. The rebuild comes first because it holds the operator entries and the batch chain both paths share; the history rebuild holds the paused path alone and the five examples verify it, so the rebuild's implementation binding claims the online path and the history rebuild shows the paused path designed apart from it. The example domain names the events the view folds, and the command declaration and the command pipeline bind the view to the commands that feed it and write it inside each command. The event envelope, the journal and the queries are where the events come from on the live path and on the backfill, and D9 is the decision that a read model which depends on history across several streams rebuilds under a write pause.

## Register rows whose sources lie in the members

22 register rows have a source in a member's file: every decided row, and every row not decided whose sources cite no open question; a row not decided that cites one is under the open questions above. 20 are decided and 2 are not. Each row gives its status and its sources in the members; a decided row gives the first sentence of its ruling, and a row not decided gives its title. [`spec:application.read-models#design.fnListOrSummary`](../specs/application/read-models.sdp.md?plain=1#L99)

```ts
export const listOrderSummaries = query({
  args: {
    tenantId: v.string(),
    status: v.union(v.literal("placed"), v.literal("cancelled")),
    paginationOpts: paginationOptsValidator,
  },
  returns: paginationResultValidator(orderSummaryView),
  handler: async (ctx, { tenantId, status, paginationOpts }) => {
    await authorizeQuery(ctx, {
      name: "listOrderSummaries",
      tenantId,
      permission: "orders.read",
    });
    const generation = await activeGeneration(ctx, "orderSummary");
    if (generation === undefined)
      throw new Error("The read model orderSummary has no active generation");
    const result = await paginator(ctx.db, schema)
      .query("orderSummaries")
      .withIndex("by_status", (q) =>
        q
          .eq("tenantId", tenantId)
          .eq("generation", generation)
          .eq("status", status),
      )
      .paginate(
        boundedPage(
          pageInGeneration(paginationOpts, [tenantId, generation, status], 5),
          limitReadModelList(orderSummary),
        ),
      );
    return { ...result, page: result.page.map(readModelView) };
  },
})
```

  name: string;

  writes: readonly SourceRef[];

  rejections: readonly string[];
  admission?: AdmissionPolicy<I>;
  bounds?: Bounds;
  retention?: Retention;
  irreversible?: boolean;
  audit?: { kind: "security" | "business" };
  diagnosticSink?: DiagnosticSink;
}

type RebuildResult =
  | {
      kind: "folded";
      state: Value;
      version: number;
      fromBaseline: number | null;
      eventsApplied: number;
      savedVersion: number;
      equal: boolean;
    }
  | {
      kind: "refused";
      reason: "tailTooLong" | "awaitingBaseline" | "budgetExhausted";
      tailLength: number;
      maxFoldEvents: number;
      savedVersion: number;
      savedSchemaVersion: number;
      currentSchemaVersion: number;

[`spec:context.queries#design.validatorRebuildResult`](../specs/context/queries.sdp.md?plain=1#L86)

```ts
const rebuildResultValidator = v.union(
  v.object({
    kind: v.literal("folded"),
    state: v.any(),
    version: v.number(),
    fromBaseline: v.union(v.number(), v.null()),
    eventsApplied: v.number(),
    savedVersion: v.number(),
    equal: v.boolean(),
  }),
  v.object({
    kind: v.literal("refused"),
    reason: v.union(
      v.literal("tailTooLong"),
      v.literal("awaitingBaseline"),
      v.literal("budgetExhausted"),
    ),
    tailLength: v.number(),
    maxFoldEvents: v.number(),
    savedVersion: v.number(),
    savedSchemaVersion: v.number(),
    currentSchemaVersion: v.number(),
  }),
)
```

[`spec:context.queries#design.parentPassThrough`](../specs/context/queries.sdp.md?plain=1#L90)

```ts
export const listOrders = query({
  args: { tenantId: v.string(), paginationOpts: paginationOptsValidator },
  returns: paginationResultValidator(orderDtoValidator),
  handler: async (ctx, args): Promise<PaginationResult<OrderDto>> => {
    await authorizeQuery(ctx, {
      name: "listOrders",
      tenantId: args.tenantId,
      permission: "orders.read",
    });
    return (await ctx.runQuery(
      components.orders.queries.order.list,
      args,
    )) as PaginationResult<OrderDto>;
  },
})
```

[`spec:context.queries#design.parentGet`](../specs/context/queries.sdp.md?plain=1#L91)

```ts
export const getOrder = query({
  args: { tenantId: v.string(), orderId: v.string() },
  returns: v.union(orderDtoValidator, v.null()),
  handler: async (ctx, { tenantId, orderId }): Promise<OrderDto | null> => {
    await authorizeQuery(ctx, {
      name: "getOrder",
      tenantId,
      permission: "orders.read",
    });
    return (await ctx.runQuery(components.orders.queries.order.get, {
      tenantId,
      streamId: orderId,
    })) as OrderDto | null;
  },
})
```
